name: City Council Meeting - Sep 24, 2024
agenda_text:
TORRANCE CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  SEPTEMBER 24, 2024
  REGULAR MEETING
  5:00 P.M. - CLOSED SESSION
  6:30 P.M. - REGULAR BUSINESS BEGINS
  IN THE LEROY J JACKSON COUNCIL CHAMBER AT 3031 TORRANCE BL.

  CITY COUNCIL MAY TAKE ACTION ON ANY ITEM LISTED ON THE AGENDA

Revised City Council Agenda 9-24-24

*Denotes the item was amended after posting of the agenda.

OPENING CEREMONIES

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

  ROLL CALL
  : Councilmembers Gerson, Kaji, Kalani, Lewis, Mattucci, Sheikh, and Mayor Chen

RECESS

14.  CLOSED SESSION

  14A. CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR (California Government Code
  §54957.6): Agency Negotiator: Aram Chaparyan Employee
  Organization/Association:
  1. Certain Full-Time Salaried and Hourly Employees
  2. Certain Part-Time Hourly Employees
  3. Crossing Guards
  4. Elected Officials
  5. Engineers and Torrance Fiscal Employees Association
  6. Executive & Management Employees
  7. Police & Fire Trainees
  8. Safety Management Employees
  9. Torrance City Employees Association
  10. Fire Safety Management
  11. Torrance Fire Fighters Association
  12. Torrance Library Employees Association
  13. Torrance Municipal Employees/AFSCME Local 1117 AFL-CIO
  14. Torrance Police Commanders Association (TPCA)
  15. Torrance Police Officers Association
  16. Torrance Professional Parks & Recreation Employees Organization
  17. Torrance Professional & Supervisory Association
  18. Torrance Recurrent Recreational Employees Organization
  19. City Treasurer
  20. City Attorney
  21. City Manager
  14A - STAFF REPORT
  RECONVENE

2.  FLAG SALUTE: Councilmember Gerson NON-SECTARIAN INVOCATION:
  Councilmember Kaji

3.  REPORT OF THE CITY CLERK ON THE POSTING OF THE AGENDA The agenda was
  posted on the Public Notice Board at 3031 Torrance Bl. and on the City’s Website on
  Tuesday, September 17, 2024 /s/ Rebecca Poirier
  3 - AFFIDAVIT
   3 - REVISED AFFIDAVIT

MOTION TO WAIVE FURTHER READING OF RESOLUTIONS AND ORDINANCES AFTER
NUMBER & TITLE – See Council Rules of Order Section 2.11 (Resolution 2006-65)

4.  ANNOUNCEMENT OF WITHDRAWN, DEFERRED, AND/OR SUPPLEMENTAL ITEMS

5.  COUNCIL COMMITTEE MEETINGS AND ANNOUNCEMENTS

6.  COMMUNITY MATTERS

  6A. PROCLAMATION declaring September 15, 2024 through October 15, 2024 as
  Hispanic Heritage Month in the City of Torrance.
  6A - STAFF REPORT

  6B. Recognition of the Seaside Heroes Park Volunteers’ 10 Year Anniversary.

7.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS #1 (Limited up to a 15-minute period) This portion of the
  meeting is reserved for comments on items under the Consent Calendar or items that
  are not on the agenda. Under the Ralph M. Brown Act, City Council cannot act on
  items raised during public comment, but may respond briefly to statements made or
  questions posed; request clarification; or refer the item to staff. Speakers under Orals
  are limited to either Oral Communications #1 or Oral Communications #2 and no
  longer than 1 minute per speaker. Time starts when you step up to the microphone. If
  presenting handout material to Council, please provide 11 copies to the City Clerk
  before speaking. Handouts will be distributed while you speak.
  PUBLIC COMMENT
  PUBLIC COMMENT RECEIVED AFTER 5:30 P.M. ON 9/23/24 AND BEFORE 1:13 A.M. ON
  9/25/24

8.  CONSENT CALENDAR
  Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion and one
  vote. There will be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed by
  a Councilmember from the Consent Calendar and considered separately..

  8A. City Manager – Approve Side Letter Agreements Regarding Implementation of
  Torrance Police Department Enhanced Recruitment and Retention Incentive Pilot
  Program. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the City Manager that City Council:
  1) Approve a side letter agreement between the Torrance City Employees Association
  (TCEA) and Management to implement Enhanced Recruitment and Retention Pilot
  Program; and
  2) Approve a side letter agreement between the Torrance Police Commanders
  Association (TPCA) and Management to implement Enhanced Recruitment and
  Retention Pilot Program; and
  3) Approve a side letter agreement between the Torrance Professional and Supervisory
  Association (TPSA) and Management to implement Enhanced Recruitment and
  Retention Pilot Program.
  8A - STAFF REPORT

  8B. City Treasurer – Accept and File Investment Report for the Month of July 2024.
  Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the City Treasurer that City Council accept and file the Investment
  Report for the month of July 2024.
  8B - STAFF REPORT

  8C. Community Services – Accept and File Update on Torrance Public Library
  Summer Reading Program. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the Community Services Director that City Council accept and file
  update on the Torrance Public Library Summer Reading Program.
  8C - STAFF REPORT

  8D. Public Works – Authorize Sole Source Purchase Order to Furnish Water
   Treatment Chemicals for North Torrance Well Field Facility. Expenditure: Not-to-
  Exceed $400,000. (Non-General Fund).
  Recommendation of the Public Works Director that City Council authorize a sole source
  purchase order with Carus Corporation of Peru, Illinois for a total not-to-exceed amount of
  $400,000 to furnish water treatment chemicals for the North Torrance Well Field Facility for
  a one-year period beginning October 1, 2024 and ending September 30, 2025.
  8D - STAFF REPORT

  8E.  City Manager – Approve Side Letter Agreement Between Torrance Municipal
  Employees-AFSCME Local 1117 (TME-AFSCME) and Management Regarding
  Temporary Parks Maintenance Contractors. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the City Manager that City Council approve the side letter agreement
  between TME-AFSCME and Management regarding temporary parks maintenance
  contractors.
  8E - STAFF REPORT

  8F.  Community Services – Accept and File Updates on Coyote Management Plan and
  Coyote Abatement Services. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the Community Services Director that City Council accept and file
  updates on the Coyote Management Plan and coyote abatement services.
  8F - STAFF REPORT
  8F - SUPPLEMENTAL

9.  ADMINISTRATIVE MATTERS

  * The following item was amended on Wednesday, September 18, 2024.

  9A. Community Services - Accept and File Update on Pickleball Facilities and
  Provide Direction Regarding Wilson Park and Sur La Brea Park Pickleball
  Facilities and El Retiro Tennis Courts. Expenditure: Approximately $16,000
  (General Fund, Pending City Council Approval).
  Recommendation of the Community Services Director that City Council:
  1) Accept and file an update regarding Park pickleball facilities; and
  2) Provide direction for restriping a tennis court at Wilson Park for pickleball and the
  restoration of the Sur La Brea tennis courts; and
  3) Provide direction for the hours of play at Sur La Brea Park tennis & pickleball courts;
  and
  4) Provide direction for staffing at the Sur La Brea Park tennis & pickleball courts.
  5) Provide direction for the nighttime hours of lighted play at the El Retiro Park tennis
  courts.
  9A - REVISED STAFF REPORT
  9A - SUPPLEMENTAL
  RECESS
  RECONVENE

  9B. City Clerk ? Adopt RESOLUTION Amending City of Torrance Conflict of Interest
  Code and Repeal Resolution No. 2023-71. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the City Clerk that City Council adopt a RESOLUTION amending the
  City of Torrance Conflict of Interest Code and repeal Resolution No. 2023-71 in its entirety.
  9B - STAFF REPORT

  9C. Water Commission and Public Works – Approve Request to Set Date for Public
  Hearing on Proposed Series of Annual Increases in Municipal Water Rates Over
  Five-Year Period of 2025 Through 2029. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the Water Commission and Public Works Director that City Council
  approve a request to set a date of November 19, 2024, for a public hearing on a proposed
  series of annual increases in municipal water rates over five-year period of 2025 through
  2029.
  9C - STAFF REPORT
  9C - STAFF PRESENTATION

  9D. Public Works – Approve Measure M Funding Agreements and Appropriate Funds
  to Torrance Fiber Network and Traffic Signal Optimization, T-195 and Hawthorne
   Boulevard Right-Turn Lanes at Lomita Boulevard and 182nd Street, T-196.
  Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the Public Works Director that City Council:
  1) Approve Measure M Funding Agreement #9200000000M550211 with the Los Angeles
  County Metropolitan Transportation Authority (LACMTA) to accept grant funding in the
  amount of $1,050,000 for Torrance Fiber Network and Traffic Signal Optimization,
  2) Upon approval of Funding Agreement #9200000000M550211, appropriate $1,050,000
  of South Bay Measure M MSP Funds to the Torrance Fiber Network and Traffic Signal
  Optimization, T-195; and
  3) Approve Measure M Funding Agreement #9200000000M550715 with the Los Angeles
  County Metropolitan Transportation Authority (LACMTA) to accept grant funding in the
  amount of $1,000,000 for Hawthorne Boulevard Right-Turn Lanes at Lomita Boulevard
  and 182nd Street, T-196; and
  4) Upon approval of Funding Agreement #9200000000M550715, appropriate $1,000,000
  of South Bay Measure M MSP Funds to the Hawthorne Boulevard Right-Turn Lanes at
  Lomita Boulevard and 182nd Street, T-196.
  9D - STAFF REPORT

9E.  Community Services – Consider and Approve Public Art Mural Policy.
  Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the Community Services Director that City Council consider and
  approve a mural policy for the City of Torrance to govern murals proposed and displayed as
  public art on public and private properties.
  9E - STAFF REPORT

9F.  City Manager – Discuss and Provide Direction on Designs for District Gateways,
  Digital, and Parks Signage. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the City Manager that City Council discuss and provide direction on
  design concepts for district gateways, digital, and parks signage.
  9F - STAFF REPORT
  9F - STAFF PRESENTATION

9G. City Manager – Accept and File Update from Office of Economic Development.
  Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the City Manager that City Council accept and file the Economic
  Development update.
  9G - STAFF REPORT
  9G - STAFF PRESENTATION

9H. Citizen Development and Enrichment Committee - Discuss and Provide Direction
  on Appropriated Resource Contributions for the Neighborhood Coordinated
  Seaside Ranchos Holiday Lights Display, Discuss and Consider Adopting an
  ORDINANCE Amending the Torrance Municipal Code Pertaining to Cottage Food,
  and Accept and File Meeting Minutes. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the Citizen Development and Enrichment Committee that City Council:
  1) Discuss and provide direction on the appropriated resource contributions to the
  neighborhood coordinated Seaside Ranchos Holiday Lights Display; and
  2) Discuss and consider amending the Cottage Food Ordinance; and
  3) Adopt an ORDINANCE amending Torrance Municipal Code (TMC) Section
  415.1.040(b) “Operating Standards” and Repealing Section 415.1.050 “Pilot Program”
  of Division 4 “Public Health and Welfare”, Chapter 15 “Cottage Food”; and
  4) Approve an ordinance summary for publication; and
  5) Accept and file the Citizen Development and Enrichment Committee meeting minutes
  from May 15, 2024.
  9H - STAFF REPORT
  9H - STAFF PRESENTATION
  9H - SUPPLEMENTAL

9I.  City Manager, City Attorney, and City Clerk – Accept and File Update on New
  Agenda and Meeting Management System, Approve Changes to City Council
  Meeting Procedures, and Adopt RESOLUTION Amending City Council Rules of
  Order. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the City Manager, City Attorney and City Clerk that City Council:
  1) Accept and file update on the new agenda and meeting management system,
   OneMeeting;
  2)  Approve changes to City Council Meeting Procedures regarding consent calendar,
  order of agenda items, public comment in advance of meetings, and use of electronic
  speaker cards; and
  3)  Adopt RESOLUTION amending Sections 2.7 and 2.12(d) of the City Council Rules of
  Order.
  9I - STAFF REPORT
  9I - MATERIALS AVAILABLE
  9I - PRESENTATION

10.  HEARINGS – None Scheduled.

11.  AGENCY AGENDAS – None Scheduled.

12.  2ND READING ORDINANCES

  12A. Second and Final reading of ORDINANCE NO. 3937 amending Section 95.1.6(c)
  entitled “Final Determination and Findings” of Chapter 5 “Conditional Use
  Permits”, of Article 1 “General”, of Division 9 “Land Use”, of the Torrance
  Municipal Code relating to the mitigation of project-related adverse impacts and
  approve the ordinance summary for publication. This item is for consideration of
  adoption of the ordinance only.
  12A - STAFF REPORT

13.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS #2 (Limited up to a 15-minute period) Council Order – Kaji,
  Kalani, Lewis, Mattucci, Sheikh, Gerson, Mayor Chen This portion of the meeting is
  reserved for comments on items not on the agenda. Under the Ralph M. Brown Act,
  City Council cannot act on items raised during public comment, but may respond
  briefly to statements made or questions posed; request clarification; or refer the item
  to staff. Speakers under Orals are limited to either Oral Communications #1 or Oral
  Communications #2 and no longer than 1 minute per speaker. Time starts when you
  step up to the microphone. If presenting handout material to Council, please provide
  11 copies to the City Clerk before speaking. Handouts will be distributed while you
  speak.

15.  ADJOURNMENT

  15A. Adjournment of City Council meeting to Tuesday, October 8, 2024, at 5:00 p.m.
  for closed session, with regular business commencing at 6:30 p.m. in the LeRoy
  J. Jackson Council Chamber. Tuesday, October 1, 2024, is a Council Dark Night.
  15A - STAFF REPORT
